newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends higher vs dlr at 1,064.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends higher vs dlr at 1,064.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso staged a comeback after trending lower over four previous sessions, ending up 6.5 pesos against the dollar at 1,064.00, interbank dealers said.
The rebound came after the peso's sharp drop Wednesday, when a central official conceded that the bank intervened by selling dollars to halt the local currency's loss of 10 pesos to the dollar.
Dealers said Thursday's session was dominated by coffee and oil exporters, who rushed to sell greenbacks and take advantage of the peso's 18.5 unit drop since Friday.
Dealers reported 422 trades for a total of $166.4 million and said the peso held in a range between 1,063.00 and 1,066.82. ((-- Juan Guillermo Londono, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
